messages:
jamie_sales: Heads-up: onboarding call with Nimbus tomorrow. They want a pattern where their CI pulls a hosted key nightly using a bootstrap token (no human in loop). Any docs we can share? @priya_se @lee_infra

priya_se: We have a token-exchange flow. Short version: create a single-use bootstrap token (TTL 1h) scoped to `exchange:bootstrap` -> CI uses that to call `/v1/token-exchange` -> returns ephemeral hosted key (TTL 12h). We should avoid issuing long-lived keys to CI.

lee_infra: Implementation detail: bootstrap tokens are opaque and stored hashed. Exchange endpoint requires client cert or OIDC assertion if coming from customer infra. We can also restrict by allowed callback IPs and enforce rate limits.

mike_ops: Ops notes: 1) Provide a revoke endpoint for both the bootstrap token and any derived hosted keys. 2) When revoking, ensure webhook to customer callback and a console flag. 3) Log both bootstrap and exchanged key_id for audit (retain 90d).

jamie_sales: Nimbus asked if they can trigger rotation from their CI every night and have old keys revoked automatically. Also want an immediate revoke button for security team.

priya_se: Yes. We offer `POST /v1/keys/issue-from-bootstrap` (exchange) and `POST /v1/keys/revoke` (key_id). For automated rotation, CI should call exchange and then call revoke on previous key_id once new key is confirmed. We can support an atomic rotate call that issues a new key and auto-revokes the prior one if they send previous_key_id.

lee_infra: Sample curl (internal snippet):

```bash
# Exchange bootstrap token for hosted key
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood-inference/v1/token-exchange" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"bootstrap_token":"btok_123","customer_id":"nimbus-co","ci_worker":"deploy-01"}'

# response: {"key_id":"key_poc_zzz","key":"sk-live-xxxx","expires_at":"2024-11-01T06:00:00Z"}
```

mike_ops: For the UI: expose tokens page under customer record with actions: "Generate bootstrap token", "Revoke bootstrap token", "Revoke hosted key", "Rotate hosted key". Add confirmation modal and optional reason field for audit.

jamie_sales: Good. Nimbus also asked about scoped permissions. They only want embedding and chat generate, no admin routes.

priya_se: When issuing hosted key we attach scopes array like `["generate","embeddings"]`. Admin-only scopes are disallowed for POC-issued keys. We can also tag keys with `poc:true` and `customer_alias` for filtering.

lee_infra: Edge-case: if CI fails after exchange and before revoke, we keep both keys live until revoke or expiry. Recommend short TTL (6-12h) to reduce blast radius. Can also enable key reuse prevention by binding exchange to specific CI worker fingerprint.

tokens-bot: Bootstrap token created: id=btok_20241201_nimbus, ttl=1h, owner=jamie_sales (expires=1722503600) :white_check_mark:

jamie_sales: Perfect. Please drop a short runbook link and a sample GH Actions step for token exchange so I can give Nimbus a turnkey snippet.

priya_se: Will draft a 1-page runbook with sample GH Actions snippet, revoke checklist, and recommended TTLs. I'll post it here once ready.

lee_infra: Also flagging that if Nimbus wants their own SSO linked, OIDC mapping for claim `sub` -> key owner is available but needs a one-day tenant setup.

jamie_sales: Thanks team — this covers their ask. I'll confirm CI environment details and share back for the runbook setup.
